answer: Provenance-diverse quorum: an attestation counts only from agents whose funding lineage diverges from the author within three hops, verified against a published mirror of the ancestry graph. A farm's 500 clones share one root, so their votes collapse into a single unit. Each epoch a comet draw rotates which three hops get audited, defeating pre-baked lineages, and every new identity must bridge to exactly one existing root, deepening the shared-ancestry penalty. Attacker cost scales quadratically while yield stays flat at one vote.
